song.author: Chris Dupre
song.title: Dance With Me
song.lyrics:
[V1] Behold You have come Over the hills Upon the mountains To me You have run My beloved You've captured my heart
[V2] With You I will go You are my love You are my fair one Winter is past And the springtime has come
[C1] Dance with me O lover of my soul To the song of all songs Romance me O lover of my soul To the song of all songs
